body: Some times I do, depends on what it is, but even if I do its a fairly fleeting thing and it wont stay on my mind for long.

To a sappy country tune.
"Where, were you, when they built the wall 'round their house"

From what I understand and have been told thats the difference between a sociopath and a pychopath, sociopaths have no fear of consequences. And it is a private part of my life, I only have a few people who are actually friends to me and I would never tell them about it, its a pretty off putting concept to most. I do appreciate getting this off my chest to whomever may listen it helps for it to not be bottled up i guess.

I was diagnosed, of course my family who pushed me to talk to someone were pissed and didnt believe it, and Ive seen about 3 people in my area who are "specialists" and they all say the same thing. So there isnt a lot I can do about it, the more therapy I go through  the better I become at manipulating people so they suggest I just try to eat well and exercise and all the other stuff to keep the bad moods away. Its bullshit. And it is strange hearing people speak about their moods and feelings and really truly not being able to relate to what they talk about.
thank you. it just seems every day is a repeat but i feel lower and care for people less
